Container.Name: correctarr
Container.Overview: Checks that every file Sonarr and Radarr own exists on disk, resolves through its symlink, passes an ffprobe read-through, and is present in Plex. Fix actions: arr re-search and Plex folder scan. Simple web GUI, no auth.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: The media path exactly as Sonarr, Radarr and Plex see it. Must include both the arr root folders and the debrid mount the symlinks point into. Use 'slave' propagation so the rclone/FUSE mount is visible.

Config.Name: PLEX_URL
Config.Description: Optional: seed the Plex URL on first start

Config.Name: PLEX_TOKEN
Config.Description: Optional: seed the Plex token on first start

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id to run as (99 = nobody)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id to run as (100 = users)
